description: This file defines the API for a text-based commit graph visualization in a Git-like version control system. It includes function declarations for initializing, updating, and displaying the graph, along with detailed documentation and usage examples.

methods.name: graph_setup_line_prefix
methods.description: Configures the global display of line_prefix diff option for the graph output.

methods.name: graph_set_column_colors
methods.description: Sets a custom scheme for column colors in the graph using ANSI or HTML escape sequences.

methods.name: graph_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new git_graph structure based on revision info.

methods.name: graph_clear
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a git_graph instance.

methods.name: graph_update
methods.description: Updates the graph with a new commit, influencing subsequent line output.

methods.name: graph_is_commit_finished
methods.description: Checks if all lines for the current commit's graph representation have been output.

methods.name: graph_next_line
methods.description: Outputs the next line of the graph into a provided strbuf, indicating commit presence.

methods.name: graph_width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the graph in characters.

methods.name: graph_show_commit
methods.description: Displays the entire commit's graph lines to stdout.

methods.name: graph_show_oneline
methods.description: Displays a single line of the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_padding
methods.description: Outputs vertical padding lines for the graph.

methods.name: graph_show_remainder
methods.description: Outputs the remaining part of the graph for the current commit.

methods.name: graph_show_commit_msg
methods.description: Prints the commit message and remainder of the graph to specified file.
